item.title: ReCast 1.3.0
item.description: Streams survive short Internet slowdowns: ReCast now buffers about 10 seconds of video on the way to Facebook instead of cutting the live after half a second. The upload speed is written to the log every minute, with a warning when it drops, and the messages after a connection drop are clearer.

item.title: ReCast 1.2.1
item.description: The update window is now always in English.

item.title: ReCast 1.2.0
item.description: Daily check at 6:00 PM with a Telegram report (permissions, keychain, Pages and tokens, Auto Live). Auto Live follows a stream started by hand without opening another player or moving the capture, and reuses the player when retrying. Player windows are closed, moved and brought to the front through the Chrome that owns them. Telegram alert if the stream goes 30 seconds without audio.

item.title: ReCast 1.1.0
item.description: First version with automatic updates (Sparkle). New identifier com.trinitycommerce.recast; preferences and secrets carry over automatically. macOS will ask again for Screen Recording, Microphone and Apple Events access.
